scorecardExplain: As if you had put the same amount into each stock at the close on the day you added it, and the same into the S&P 500 on those days. You didn't buy these. Stocks you removed still count, up to the day they left.
scorecardStartsTomorrow: Measured from today's close. Check back tomorrow.
scorecardChartNote: Each stock joins at 0% on the day you added it, so the line can step when you add one. The S&P 500 line steps on the same days.
scorecardChartEmpty: Not enough history yet. Check back after the next close.
scorecardChartError: Could not load the chart. Try again in a minute.

scorecardChartProBody: Pro charts your picks against the S&P 500, close by close, since the first one you added.
